## Earnie 2.4.0

Official **2.4.0** after the community alpha line (`2.4.0-alpha.*`). Focus: **EHAL** southbound foundation, Loxone on EHAL, DACH docking (OpenEMS + Home Assistant / evcc), LoxBerry Scope A, and release hardening.

### Highlights

- **EHAL** — frozen schema and adapters; production Loxone I/O via EHAL (`ehal_bindings`); residual Merker nests retired; Homie bridge defaults removed
- **Southbounds** — OpenEMS Compose path (prototype/industrial); Home Assistant + evcc (Path A2 / DACH default messaging); config-switch across OpenEMS ↔ HA+evcc ↔ Loxone
- **LoxBerry** — Scope A MVP plugin (thin Docker wrapper in `packaging/loxberry/`)
- **Mapping / ops** — MCP one-click Loxone mapping; hardware-registry first approach; greenfield Loxone import without old `BRIDGE_DEFAULTS`
- **Intake** — GitHub Issues as public ticket intake; Streamlit Kontakt → prefilled Issue; `support@earnie-hems.com` for private registry/secrets
- **Quality** — legacy/soft-compat and dual-key bridges removed (fail-fast); coverage baseline; docs review + consolidation; sidebar logos (light/dark)

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.4.0`
- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:latest`
- Legacy aliases: `ghcr.io/jochentcc/ernie-energy:2.4.0` / `:latest`

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

Deploy: [docs/einrichtung/container.md](https://github.com/JochenTCC/Earnie/blob/main/docs/einrichtung/container.md)

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology_productive.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology_productive.yml up -d
```

(Same pattern for `loxberry_productive.yml` / `proxmox_productive.yml`.)

### Carry-over

- Feature work continues in **2.5** (15‑min slots investigation) and later backlog chapters
- Alpha compose files remain pinned to the last pre-release (`2.4.0-alpha.6`) until the next community bump

See [backlog/Backlog.md](https://github.com/JochenTCC/Earnie/blob/main/backlog/Backlog.md) · [backlog/Backlog-Bugfixes.md](https://github.com/JochenTCC/Earnie/blob/main/backlog/Backlog-Bugfixes.md).
